page.overview:
Who is Benton?

Benton is a contestant in the 59th Card Wars Doubles Classic who appears in the episode "Daddy-Daughter Card Wars". He is seen with Mike R. as Jake walks Charlie through the room, playing cards in a non-tournament match.

Benton is made almost entirely out of wood, such as a log and two hammers. However, he is still able to move, albeit rather stiffly.
